name: pi-lsp-vendored
description: Vendored pi-lsp 0.1.7 (npm, no public repo) + patch: diagnostics notice via ctx.ui.notify instead of an empty steer message. Upstream sends sendMessage({content:''}, {deliverAs:'steer'}) on every diagnostics hit, which lands as an empty user turn and derails multi-step briefs (subagents, -p mode). Run `npm install` here after clone. Diff vs upstream: 0001-notify-instead-of-empty-steer.patch (also import paths ../_shared → ./_shared).
